children.title: Love@AOV
children.description: A look back at a classic keyword idea. AOV does not operate a dating service.

sections.title: Love@AOV
paragraphs: The Love@AOV keyword is part of the nostalgia directory. There is no AOV dating site, matchmaking, or dating profile system.
You can still use the regular Buddy List and chat rooms to connect with other members. Please respect other members' boundaries and use blocking or reporting when needed.

sections.title: People on AOV
paragraphs: Chat rooms are public conversations. The Buddy List helps you keep up with screen names you know, while instant messages are one-to-one.
